{{Quote|This is the safest place in town. Get the citizens to here and we'll hold out till the end.|Javran Mu, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TA" />}}
'''Javran Mu''' was the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] manager of the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] became involved in the [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|Battle of Mos Espa]], when [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] led by the [[Tusken King]] launched an attack on the [[City/Legends|city]]. Believing the hotel to be the safest place in town, he had the city's residents hole up inside inside the building until the battle came to an end.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Javran Mu was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Javran Mu was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Tusken Army|"Tusken Army" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:TA" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
